title: notifications.v1.NotificationSent
description: A message was handed to a delivery channel and accepted by it. This means 'the provider took it', not 'the customer read it' — this system has no delivery receipt. Nothing subscribes to this topic; it exists so that the notifications service's behaviour is observable and auditable rather than a black hole at the end of the pipeline.

source_event_id.description: The event_id that triggered this notification. Together with `channel` it forms the uniqueness key that stops a redelivered OrderConfirmed from emailing the customer twice.

template.description: Template identifier, e.g. order_confirmed. Not the rendered body — message content is never published to Kafka.

recipient_hash.description: SHA-256 of the recipient address. The address itself is deliberately NOT published: this topic has a long retention and there is no reason for personal data to sit in it. The hash is enough to correlate and to prove a duplicate was avoided.

provider_message_id.description: Identifier returned by the delivery provider, for support queries. Absent for the built-in log sender.

attempts.description: How many tries it took, including the successful one.
